title: Fix blank white page rendering issue in versions 9-12

requirements.text: Verify that frontend/index.html contains a root div element with id='root' in the body section, and if missing or malformed, add the correct markup:

quotes: in the last 3 to 4 versions including the last one i can't see the preview screen it only shows blank white page

acceptanceCriteria:
frontend/index.html contains
in the body section
The root div has no conflicting attributes or styles that prevent rendering

requirements.text: Verify that frontend/src/main.tsx correctly targets the root element using document.getElementById('root') with a null check, and if the element is not found, logs a clear error message to console and displays a visible error on the page
acceptanceCriteria: main.tsx uses document.getElementById('root') to get the root element
A null check is present before calling createRoot
If root element is missing, console.error logs 'Root element #root not found'
If root element is missing, a visible error message appears in document.body

requirements.text: Wrap the ReactDOM.createRoot and root.render calls in frontend/src/main.tsx in a try-catch block that catches initialization errors, logs them with full stack traces to console.error, and displays a user-visible error message directly in document.body
acceptanceCriteria: try-catch block wraps createRoot and render calls
Caught errors are logged to console.error with stack traces
Caught errors display visible error message in document.body with red background
Error message includes the error name and message

requirements.text: Add console.log statements at three strategic points in frontend/src/main.tsx: at the very beginning (before imports if possible), after imports, and immediately before the createRoot call, logging 'main.tsx: Script execution started', 'main.tsx: Imports completed', and 'main.tsx: Mounting React app'
acceptanceCriteria: console.log at the beginning of main.tsx logs 'main.tsx: Script execution started'
console.log after imports logs 'main.tsx: Imports completed'
console.log before createRoot logs 'main.tsx: Mounting React app'
All three console logs appear in browser console during app initialization

requirements.text: Verify that all import statements in frontend/src/main.tsx resolve correctly by ensuring imported modules (React, ReactDOM, App component, QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider) have valid exports and wrap critical imports in try-catch blocks if module resolution errors are suspected
acceptanceCriteria: All imports in main.tsx resolve without errors
If any import fails, a try-catch block catches it and logs the specific module that failed
Browser console shows clear error messages if imports fail

requirements.text: Add defensive error handling to InternetIdentityProvider in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts by wrapping AuthClient initialization and any async calls in try-catch blocks, logging errors to console, and providing fallback to unauthenticated state instead of throwing uncaught errors
acceptanceCriteria: AuthClient initialization is wrapped in try-catch
Errors during authentication setup are logged to console.error
Application continues to render with unauthenticated state if authentication setup fails
No uncaught exceptions are thrown from useInternetIdentity hook

requirements.text: Verify that the App component in frontend/src/App.tsx has a valid default export and renders without throwing errors by temporarily simplifying its content to return a single div with text 'App component loaded' to isolate rendering issues
acceptanceCriteria: App component has default export
Simplified App component renders successfully
Browser displays 'App component loaded' text when simplified
No JavaScript errors appear in console when rendering simplified App

requirements.text: Verify that the ErrorBoundary component in frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx is correctly wrapping the App component in frontend/src/main.tsx and that it includes comprehensive console.error logging in componentDidCatch with error message, stack trace, and component stack
acceptanceCriteria: ErrorBoundary wraps <App /> in main.tsx
componentDidCatch method logs error.message to console.error
componentDidCatch method logs error.stack to console.error
componentDidCatch method logs errorInfo.componentStack to console.error
ErrorBoundary fallback UI is visible when errors are caught

requirements.text: Check browser developer tools Network tab for failed resource loads (404, CORS errors, or failed JS bundle loads) and verify that frontend/src/main.tsx and all imported JavaScript bundles load successfully with 200 status codes
acceptanceCriteria: main.tsx loads with 200 status code
All JavaScript bundles load without 404 errors
No CORS errors in browser console
All static assets required by the app load successfully

requirements.text: Check that BurnoutMonitoring component and its child components (BurnoutWarning, GreyscaleOverlay, BlockScreen) in frontend/src/App.tsx do not cause render crashes by verifying all required props and state dependencies are defined and hooks (useBurnoutMonitor, useBlockingLogic) return valid data before rendering child components
acceptanceCriteria: useBurnoutMonitor hook returns valid burnout index before rendering warnings
useBlockingLogic hook returns valid isBlocked state
All child components check for undefined/null values before rendering
No 'Cannot read property of undefined' errors in console

constraints: Do not modify the backend/main.mo actor structure
Do not change the Internet Identity authentication flow
Preserve all existing functionality while fixing the rendering issue
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts beyond adding error handling
